get.summary: Get collections a user has access to.
get.description: Get collections a user has access to, with optional filters and pagination.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: If specified, return collections for this user rather than for the authenticated user. The authenticated user must have admin role if this parameter is used.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: If specified, return collections that have the provided string in their name.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of collections to return. If unset or set to a negative value, return all collections.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of collections to skip.

404.description: User does not exist, or extension not supported.
